openTasks.title: Build per-project compliance settings UI
openTasks.note: Per-project framework enablement ships in the AdminDashboard Edit Audit modal, fenced [SCOPE 112 / T006], carrying all six frameworks. AuditConfigPanel is project-scoped and ADMIN-gated but renders only four toggles — nistssdfenabled and iso27001enabled have columns, an API contract and an MCP surface, but no control in that panel.
